name: Ninh Binh
tagline: Ha Long Bay on land, with rice fields and river caves
summary: Around Ninh Binh, limestone peaks rise from rice paddies and rivers that flow through caves. Rowing boats carry visitors through Trang An and Tam Coc, while temples, an ancient capital and a hilltop viewpoint fill the rest of a stay.
seasonNote: Late May to early June brings golden rice in Tam Coc. Spring and autumn are mild. Summer is hot and wet; winter is cool and grey.
arrival: Trains and buses from Hanoi take about 2 to 2.5 hours. Many hotels arrange pickups.
gettingAround: Rent a bicycle or scooter, or hire a car; the sights are spread out.
cashTip: Vietnamese dong cash is essential at stalls, boats and markets; check note denominations carefully.
foodTip: Mountain goat meat and crispy rice (cơm cháy).
buyTip: Embroidery from Van Lam village near Tam Coc.
baseArea: Tam Coc or Trang An homestays

connections.note: Several trains a day; buses take about 2 hours.
